f3e1b8bd: ;
;DGJOTP3 is the primary routine for printing the Transcription
;Productivity Report by Physician or Service/Specialty.
;This routine contains the following sections:
; SET - Initialize counters for each division
; TOT - Print totals for each division
; HEAD1 - Print header for the Productivity Report
; RET1 - Pause and continue printing
; RELP - Print header if necessary
; HEAD - Print the main report header
; PH - Print the physician report totals
; SV - Print the service/specialty report totals
; LIST - Get and print the output for each physician/service
; WR - Print the detail lines for each physician/service
; EXT - Format numeric values for output
; CNTWR - Print the count totals for each physician/service
; DIVTOT - Accumulate division totals
;The routine is accessed from DGJOTP and shares variables in DGJOTP.
